items.text: SEASON 2 · EPISODE 11 · BOSS LEVEL · DRAFT  Live event and load-in — RF, rigging boundaries, signal and crew pressure · Level 1  The final show of the Halyard Live tour: an arena, a four-hour turnaround, and a wireless band so crowded the scanner looks like a city skyline. The promoter wants doors early. Ben, the head rigger, is at lunch.  ⚑ CH-01 · BOSS-01: five physics challenges, a signal trace and the calls that aren't yours to make — on the clock. Fail anything and the run starts over. The edge of the screen glows yellow under pressure, red when time is short or the run fails, green when you clear it; it pulses no faster than once a second, and holds steady if you prefer reduced motion.

Wouldn't dream of it. Your truss, your signature.

items.caption: Trace · hear · see · reach · build · record. The boss isn't the fault — it's the pressure to cut a corner.

lines.text: One check per stage. If it fails, we start over from the top — and we'll know why.
Then we start again. That's the job: until it passes, and we can prove it.

items.caption: Cleared. Written down. Handed over.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Under pressure, the method doesn't change: trace the signal from source to destination, fix one thing at a time and prove it where the people are, and hand every decision that isn't yours to the person who owns it — the electrician, the rigger and structural engineer, the network owner, security, the emergency managers, the clinical and privacy owners, the artist. Then write it down.
